tech_depth.evidence: Bio: "DB도 로그인도 백엔드도 없이 공개 Git 저장소 하나로 돌아가고, 커밋 작성자가 곧 신원 확인입니다." This is an architectural choice, but there is no rationale detail, measurement, or code evidence; GitHub shows 1 repo, 0 stars.
tech_depth.fix: Add a short architecture note in the README explaining how commit-author identity verification works, its limits (e.g. spoofed git emails), and how you handle them.

traction.evidence: No user counts, profiles created, traffic, or revenue anywhere; mrr_band is "none"; GitHub account created 2026-09-25 with 0 stars.
traction.fix: Publish concrete numbers (profiles submitted, visitors, merged PRs) with dates, and show an analytics screenshot.

differentiation.evidence: Tagline and landing text: "every claim carries a public evidence link", aimed at companies and investors who verify. The angle is distinct, but no proprietary data, contributions or awards are visible.
differentiation.fix: Show 3–5 real example profiles whose evidence links check out, to prove the concept works and is hard to copy.

evidence.evidence: Live URL exists and the screenshot shows a bilingual landing page with a clear two-sentence explanation; GitHub is public. But the screenshot shows only a language chooser, with no demo of an actual profile or evaluation.
evidence.fix: Put a sample profile and a 30-second demo or GIF on the landing page, and link the repo prominently.

commercial.evidence: Targets "companies and investors who want to verify before they hire or invest", but no pricing, revenue model, waitlist or pilots are stated; mrr_band "none".
commercial.fix: State who pays and how much (e.g. recruiter plan per month) and start a waitlist with a visible count.

design.evidence: Screenshot 1: clean, centered card, consistent font, clear hierarchy, readable in 3 seconds. However the page is sparse, with a lot of empty space, no call to action and no product visuals.
design.fix: Add a primary call-to-action (view sample profile / submit yours) and a visual preview of a profile.

innovation.evidence: Evidence-required résumés with Git commit identity and no backend is a somewhat fresh take on verified portfolios, but the visible material only describes it; it is not demonstrated.
innovation.fix: Demonstrate an automated evidence-link check (e.g. CI that validates each claim's URL) to show real novelty beyond the idea.

summary.en: A clean, clearly stated concept (evidence-linked résumés on a pure public Git repo), but there are no users, revenue, metrics or visible product depth beyond a bilingual landing screen. Only one repo with 0 stars and no experience entries, so most claims are unverified.
summary.ko: 증거 링크 기반 이력서라는 개념과 'Git 저장소만으로 동작'한다는 구조는 명확하지만, 사용자·매출·지표나 랜딩 화면 이상의 제품 깊이는 보이지 않습니다. 저장소 1개, 스타 0개로 대부분의 주장이 검증되지 않았습니다.
